p3.title: Buildings in a town
task: A town has a large public building that is empty. The people in the town want to use the building.
Here are some ideas for how to use the building.
Talk together about the different ways the people of the town could use the empty building and say which would be best.

p4: Where do you like going in your town? (Why?)

When was the last time you went to the cinema?
Do you prefer modern buildings or old buildings? (Why?)
Is it important to look after old buildings? (Why?/Why not?)
